description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing group policies, channel configurations, sender policies, and access control within a messaging or communication platform. It includes functions for resolving group configurations, sender policies, and channel permissions, as well as handling deprecated sender key formats.

methods.name: resolveChannelGroupConfig
methods.description: Resolves a specific channel group configuration by group ID, with optional case insensitivity.

methods.name: resolveChannelGroupPolicy
methods.description: Determines the policy for a channel group, including whether it is allowlisted, allowed, and its configuration.

methods.name: resolveChannelGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Decides if a mention is required in a channel group based on configuration and overrides.

methods.name: resolveChannelGroupToolsPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the tools policy for a channel group, considering sender-specific policies and defaults.
